recommendation: Implement comprehensive care coordination for asthma patients across settings
implementation_steps: Facilitate seamless communication and integration of asthma management across home, school, community, and healthcare settings
Facilitate the development and implementation of personalized asthma action plans (AAPs)
Ensure timely communication between primary care providers and specialists
Coordinate access to Medicaid-funded programs and social services for eligible patients
Address logistical barriers such as transportation and scheduling to improve adherence to asthma care plans
evidence_summary: Care coordination interventions that integrate asthma management across multiple settings have been shown to improve asthma control, reduce emergency department visits, and enhance quality of life, particularly for children with asthma.
citation: Ensuring Equitable Access to Guideline-Based Asthma Care Across the Lifespan: Tips and Future Directions to the Successful Implementation of the New NAEPP 2020 Guidelines, a Work Group Report of the AAAAI Asthma, Cough, Diagnosis, and Treatment Committee. (2023)
